§6First Nuclear Bomb§f

§aYour first atomic detonation.§f
Craft a §bNuclear Bomb§f using enriched uranium or plutonium, conventional explosives, and detonation wiring. Place it, wire it to a §bRedstone§f signal, and detonate from a safe distance.

The explosion destroys a significant area and leaves behind §bTrinitite Glass§f. The blast also generates radiation that will contaminate the surrounding area for a while. Make sure you're prepared for the cleanup.

§cWARNING:§f This will destroy terrain. Test far from your base. We are not responsible for your house or your cat.

§ePS:§f The Trinitite Glass left behind has uses in advanced recipes. Don't just ignore the crater, collect the glass before it despawns.
